changelog: New: tablet mode and tiling mode; privacy mode (hides notification text and, in the app, screenshots and screen sharing); the Alt+Tab window switcher; a new Browser with a sidebar (spaces, favourites, a photo on the new tab page); updates in two steps (the update is downloaded in the background, then installed on restart with a progress screen); a much more capable Terminal (pipes, scripts, network commands); Sandbox snapshots, logs and export; Store sources, app versions, screenshots and sideload; Activation in Settings > About. The project is spelled hyadeOS everywhere; the GitHub address stays hyadeOSS.
